gaps.lead: I don't expect the company to make a profit this year, given the economic climate.
gaps.sentence: Given the economic climate, ___ the company made a profit this year.
gaps.hint: don't expect = would be surprised if + past
gaps.explanation: A tentative prediction: 'I would be surprised if + past simple'.

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees himself.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who…' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: It would be unwise for you to complain to the manager directly.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be unwise' = 'you had better not' — had better + not + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: You must complete the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: must complete → must be completed (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: 'You mustn't run near the pool,' the lifeguard told the children.
gaps.sentence: The lifeguard told the children ___ near the pool.

gaps.explanation: last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
